hypothesis: Two person-typed recalls of one sealed fixture id, entered before the fixture line is shown, hash to a token gap between the recalls. The gap is a hypothesis of disagreement between two local notes. It is not a collective-memory seal, not a timeline proof, and not a score against the fixture.
observation: A person types two recalls in sequence for one closed fixture id. The page withholds the sealed line until both are sealed.
claim: A token gap between two recalls is sometimes read, off this page, as evidence that a public line changed. This page does not make that reading.
inference_denied: Agreement between the two recalls is not a shared-reality seal. Disagreement is not a timeline proof. A later look at the sealed line is not a correction score.
disconfirm: A primary record the person can check outside this page, named in the note. This page does not fetch it.
confidence: design-material weight typed by the person, not a measurement
differs_from: local-collective-miss-board compared one recall to a visible fixture and stored a match flag. This draft withholds the line, requires a second recall, and hashes only the gap between the two recalls.
